customers: Patients through doctors, insurers, governments and pharmacies.
money: Skyrizi and Rinvoq, with Humira declining
Imbruvica, Venclexta and newer cancer drugs

watch: Combined Skyrizi and Rinvoq sales and the pace of debt reduction.
